description: The organization has not established a formal process for resolving security incidents. This signal indicates the absence of documented procedures for investigating, containing, and remediating security incidents.
applicability: Organizations pursuing SOC 2 certification, Service organizations requiring incident management capabilities

metadata.detection_notes: Detection involves reviewing incident response procedures, examining resolution workflows, and verifying that root cause analysis processes exist.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC7 System Operations
